Three modes: STORE mode auto-captures when the AI detects meaningful new knowledge (concepts, principles, techniques, mental models, problem solutions). RECALL mode triggers only when the user explicitly asks to review, search, or recall stored knowledge (e.g., 我学过什么, 帮我回顾, 记忆里有什么, 搜索我之前学到的). BACKFILL mode (v2) runs a cross-conversation sync that recovers knowledge missed in specialized scenes (expert/course scenes where this skill is not injected) — triggered by 同步记忆, 补录记忆, 同步一下 or a daily automation. Most of the time Engram passively stores; active retrieval happens only on explicit user request.
